programs.title: Badi Maa Chhoti Maa
programs.desc: Frustrated by societal pressures, a woman decides for her husband to marry someone else. Soon, the man marries again, and the new bride delivers him a son, but challenges soon arise.

programs.title: Sasural Ke Gulam
programs.desc: A man gets married into a wealthy household and moves away from his simple parents and starts living with his wife's family.

programs.title: Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi
programs.desc: When Sadhana marries Deepak, her manipulative mother urges her to harass her mother-in-law. Subsequently, she also meddles in her son's marriage, turning their lives into a web of misery.

programs.title: Vidya
programs.desc: Vidya, the daughter of a rickshaw driver, faces numerous rejections in her marriage due to dowry issues. Later, she becomes an IAS officer and takes stringent actions against dowry.

programs.title: Meri Saas Pehle Aap
programs.desc: A newly-married woman shares a close bond with her mother-in-law. Later, they become each other's support when the other daughter-in-law begins to plot against them.

programs.title: Naukar Biwi Ka
programs.desc: A proud orphan snottily rejects the poor young man she's been betrothed to since birth. Despite the rejection, the young man endeavours to win his fiancée's affection and avenge his humiliation.
